name: Neostigmine
summary: Neostigmine, sold under the brand name Bloxiverz, among others, is a cholinesterase inhibitor; as a medication, it is used to treat paralysis, myasthenia gravis, Ogilvie syndrome, and urinary retention without the presence of a blockage. It is also used in anaesthesia to end the effects of non-depolarising neuromuscular blocking medication. It is given by injection either into a vein, muscle, or under the skin.
